item.title: The Sri Lanka Red Cross Society Provides Cash Assistance to Flood-Affected Migrants
item.description: The Sri Lanka Red Cross Society (SLRCS) provided unconditional cash grants to 156 flood-affected migrants/refugees residing in the Gampaha District, enabling them to address their most urgent needs and begin recovering from the impact of the disaster.
